name: Agent-Reach
description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
one_liner: A tool that lets an AI assistant browse and search social media and video sites — Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — through one command, without paying for each site's official API.
buyer: A marketing agency running AI research agents that needs cross-platform social listening without stacking five separate paid API subscriptions.
business_use_cases: A marketing agency builds an automated competitor-monitoring bot that pulls brand mentions across Twitter, Reddit, and YouTube comments every morning.
A hedge fund analyst's AI agent scans Reddit and Twitter sentiment on a stock ticker before market open instead of paying for a Bloomberg-style social feed.
A China-market consultant builds an agent that watches XiaoHongShu and Bilibili trends for a Western brand trying to spot what's going viral there.

money_ideas.idea: Package it as a hosted 'social listening for AI agents' API and charge agencies per seat or per request, since most teams don't want to run and maintain scraping infrastructure themselves.

steal_this: This weekend, wrap it in a simple dashboard that runs a daily cross-platform mention report for one brand, and pitch it to a local business as the start of a bigger retainer.
